name: rainbow-button
title: Rainbow Button
description: A rounded white button with dark text, trimmed by a thin animated rainbow border that blurs into a soft coloured halo under the bottom edge.
use: A prominent action wants a colourful celebratory accent while its label stays plain and legible.
avoid: Serious or brand-strict pages where a multicoloured glow clashes, and dark themes where a white body glares.
a11y: The rainbow slides forever and is not paused for users who ask for reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white rounded rectangle with black, medium-weight text sits on a black stage. A thin rainbow line runs along its edge, blue through pink to red, and a blurred copy of that gradient bleeds out below the bottom like a soft light.
behaves: The rainbow gradient slides sideways on a loop, so the trim and the glow beneath slowly change hue. Pressing nothing changes it; it also gets a focus ring and a dimmed disabled look from its classes.
customise: The label is children; variant, size, asChild and className are props, while the five rainbow colours are CSS variables defined in the source.
weight: light: One button with two CSS gradients and a blurred pseudo-element on a single keyframe.
